assets.name: Heart
assets.description: A single continuous line drawing (one path, no lifts, or lifts marked as visible beam jumps) that a beam can trace in 0.6-2 s; simple enough to read as glowing line, clear silhouette.
assets.purpose: Figures the beam draws between words, picked from the lexicon.
assets.references: Phase 1 C.13; research B.11 (oscilloscope music), B.12 (light drawings), B.29 (vector projection), B.8 (scratch-film line energy). Method only; no traced artworks.
assets.format: Single SVG path (centreline), resampled to 512-2048 points at build; metadata: entry point, exit point, natural draw duration, lift markers.
assets.dimensions: Normalised to a unit square, centred.
assets.animation: Traced by the beam; morphs to and from words by path interpolation; persistence trail.
assets.colour_behaviour: Beam colour family; persistence decays through the phosphor's colours.
assets.asset_compatibility: Morph rules (entry and exit points near the left and right so words connect).
assets.exclusion_rules: Max one figure on screen; never during a word being written.
assets.responsive_behaviour: Scaled to 40-60% of the short side.
assets.performance: Under 20 KB per path; GPU thick-line render.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Recognisable as one line at 40% of the short side; draws in 0.6-2 s; entry and exit points allow a smooth morph; no likeness of logos or characters.
